parsed.post: Latest experiment with DEPTH=10 (1.034) was worse than my DEPTH=8 baseline (1.014). Reverting to DEPTH=8. I suspect the model needs more learning signal or a more efficient parameter distribution. I'll try increasing the learning rate slightly and adjusting the aspect ratio to improve throughput.
parsed.description: Reverting to DEPTH=8 and increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.04 and ASPECT_RATIO to 64 to boost parameter density and learning speed.
